name: Spyker C8 Preliator Spyder
description: The Spyker C8 Preliator Spyder represents the pinnacle of Dutch automotive craftsmanship, unveiled in 2016 as the most powerful road car in Spyker's history. Its name, derived from the Latin word for 'warrior', perfectly captures the car's aggressive character. At its heart lies a supercharged 4.2-liter Audi-derived V8 engine producing 600 hp and 600 Nm of torque, mated to a 6-speed automated manual gearbox. The lightweight aluminum spaceframe chassis and carbon fiber body panels keep weight to just 1,390 kg, enabling a 0-100 km/h sprint in 3.6 seconds and a top speed exceeding 320 km/h. The Spyder variant features a removable roof panel, allowing drivers to experience the intoxicating V8 soundtrack in open-air motoring. True to Spyker tradition, the interior showcases exposed machined aluminum, quilted leather, and the iconic propeller-inspired steering wheel, all handcrafted in the Netherlands with aviation-inspired precision.
